name: Terminal methoxyethanol motif
rationale: Methyl glycol ether and metabolic activation to methoxyacetaldehyde/methoxyacetic acid; contrasts C3–C4 hemolysis feature.
limitation: Very narrow, effectively identifies EGME; may not generalize; exclude from final model unless justified independently.

name: Para benzenediol motif
rationale: Hydroquinone / quinone conversion and marrow cell toxicity.
limitation: Broad proxy for substituted analogues; overlaps HT06 for some alkyl-substituted molecules; not validated hazard rule.

name: Ortho benzenediol motif
rationale: Catechol toxicity in marrow progenitor/stromal cell assays.
limitation: Broad proxy; in vitro mechanism evidence; not an in vivo predictor; overlaps HT06 for some alkyl-substituted molecules.
